ingest.note: The Agent framework delivers normalized 16 kHz PCM frames to your worker regardless of the underlying transport.

egress.note: Agent audio output is published as PCM and re-encoded to Opus for the WebRTC room; for PSTN it is re-encoded to μ-law by the SIP trunk.

potholes.note: When using LiveKit's SIP trunk / dialin, LiveKit performs the μ-law↔PCM and 8k↔16k conversion server-side, so your agent sees 16 kHz PCM. If you instead bridge a raw telephony websocket yourself, you own that conversion.
LiveKit interruption is detected from the input track; you must clear/republish the outbound stream segment to actually stop playback to the caller.

cost_estimates.notes: LiveKit Cloud per-participant. Self-hosted is free.

latency_evidence.methodology: Callsmith architecture-budget placeholder; benchmark in the deployment region before setting an SLO.

interruption.description: AgentSession with TurnHandlingOptions(turn_detection=MultilingualModel()) handles interruption automatically. When user speech is detected during agent output, the session cancels in-flight TTS and LLM output.
